title: Inference and model handling fixes completed
content:
Inference and model handling fixes completed:
1. KVCache dual-storage inconsistency — len() unified with seq_len(), vector entries auto-merge into packed storage on append via std::mem::take
2. MHA forward_with_caching early returns — all reshape failure paths now compute and append new_k/new_v to KV cache before returning, preventing corrupt inference state during incremental decoding
3. TransformerBlock single-token step API (inspired by llm-from-scratch/architecture) — added forward_single_token(), init_kv_cache_for_seq_len(), reset_kv_cache()
4. llm-from-scratch/architecture cleaned up — removed after extracting useful patterns into project

Build clean, zero warnings, 7/7 KV cache tests pass.
